1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 6 m de altura, copa abierta, hojas alternas, elípticas, y flores solitarias de color blanquecino. Rutaceae, Citrus limon.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Shrub reaching up to 6 m in height, open canopy, alternate leaves that are elliptical in shape, and solitary flowers of a whitish color.

Family Rutaceae, genus Citrus, species limon.
